items.followUp: Describe the roles of the small intestine in digestion.

rubric.why: The stomach’s muscular walls churn food and mix it with gastric juice.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the stomach churns or mixes food with gastric juice.

rubric.why: Hydrochloric acid makes the stomach contents acidic and helps kill germs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct role of hydrochloric acid in the stomach.

rubric.why: Pepsin digests proteins into smaller peptides.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that pepsin digests proteins into peptides.

rubric.why: Mucus protects the stomach lining from acid and digestive enzymes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that mucus protects the stomach lining or wall.

rubric.why: The partly digested food, called chyme, passes from the stomach into the small intestine.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying chyme and stating that it passes into the small intestine.

modelAnswer: The muscular walls of the stomach churn and mix food with gastric juice.
Hydrochloric acid in gastric juice makes the contents acidic and helps kill germs.
Pepsin digests proteins into smaller peptides.
Mucus protects the lining of the stomach from acid and digestive enzymes.
The partly digested, semi-liquid food is called chyme and passes into the small intestine.

rubric.why: Horticulture provides useful produce, including fruits and vegetables.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming a food or useful plant product provided by horticulture.

rubric.why: Horticulture can provide economic benefits or beautify surroundings through ornamental plants.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one distinct benefit, such as income, employment or beautification.

modelAnswer: Horticulture provides fruits, vegetables and flowers for food and other uses.
It creates income and employment, and ornamental plants beautify the surroundings.

items.followUp: What is biotechnology, and how is it useful to people?

rubric.why: Bioeconomics concerns the economic use of biological knowledge, resources and products.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking biology or biological resources/products with economic use.

rubric.why: Bioeconomics helps people use biological resources effectively and gain economic benefits.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that it supports effective use of biological resources or economic benefit from them.

modelAnswer: Bioeconomics deals with the economic use of biological knowledge, resources and products.
It helps people make effective use of biological resources and gain economic benefits from them.
